termZh: 打印 - 颜色 - 规范
definitionZh: 打印-彩色-adjust CSS 属性设置,如果有的话,用户代理可以做些什么来优化元素在输出设备上的外观. 默认情况下,鉴于输出设备的类型和能力,浏览器被允许对元素的外观作任何它认定是必要和谨慎的调整.
sourceDefinition: The print-color-adjust CSS property sets what, if anything, the user agent may do to optimize the appearance of the element on the output device. By default, the browser is allowed to make any adjustments to the element's appearance it determines to be necessary and prudent given the type and capabilities of the output device.
